example.output: WPM, CPM, accuracy %, mistakes, local history, downloadable certificate

faqs: How is WPM calculated?
Words per minute is based on correct characters (typically characters ÷ 5) over elapsed time, alongside CPM and accuracy.
Is history saved?
Yes. Attempts are stored in LocalStorage on your device when authentication is unavailable—leaderboard-ready architecture for later.
Can I download a certificate?
Yes. Enter your name after a completed test and download a PDF certificate with WPM and accuracy.
Does this use AI?
No. The typing speed test is pure client logic for responsive, lag-free typing.
Which durations are available?
Common timed options such as 30, 60, and 120 seconds.
